purpose: Candidate public datasets for testing whether existing data can be reorganized into event-native learning benchmarks before collecting new physical data.
audit_questions: Can the dataset be represented as event_id -> conditions -> indexed observations -> labels/probes?
Does it contain time-indexed or position-indexed raw observations?
Does it preserve process variables or recipe/condition fields?
Does it include repeated events under similar planned conditions?
Does it preserve failed, partial, ambiguous, or negative attempts?
Can we define early-trace -> future-observation prediction without relying on labels?
Can we define shortcut controls such as source-only, recipe-only, label-only, and interpolation baselines?
Are access and license conditions compatible with reuse?

first_benchmark_task.name: early_trace_to_future_observation
first_benchmark_task.description: Given an early subset of an event trace, predict a later raw observation, final raw observation, or final measurement embedding.
first_benchmark_task.target_claim_if_positive: Raw event traces contain useful feedback that is lost by recipe-only or final-label-only views.
first_benchmark_task.target_claim_if_negative: The dataset contains scientific data, but its structure cannot test event-native learning because required event fields are missing.

candidates.title: Evaporation of alcohol droplets on surfaces in moist air
candidates.why_relevant: Small open dataset with time-dependent droplet behavior and controlled humidity. Good first audit for early-trace prediction.
likely_strengths: raw-ish videos rather than only final labels
likely_limitations_to_audit: unclear whether traces are directly aligned to machine-readable condition rows

readme_signals: Movies are mapped to RH, nozzle, substrate, and trace-particle conditions.
Several supporting movies or datasets are described as available under request.
The archive is organized around paper figures rather than an event manifest.
local_audit.preliminary_verdict: Useful first event-trace smoke test, but not a decisive event-native benchmark because repeats, complete released traces, failed/ambiguous attempts, and provenance are incomplete.

smoke_test.task: first 25% video-derived trace -> last 25% trace summary
smoke_test.verdict: Early trace features contain signal but do not beat metadata-only baselines in this 9-video release, so the dataset can prototype the event task but cannot decide the main benchmark question.

candidates.title: MARCO: MAchine Recognition of Crystallization Outcomes
candidates.reported_size: 462,804 scored images from five source institutions
candidates.why_relevant: Large public image dataset that is useful as a final-label compression baseline and provenance-shortcut stress test.
likely_limitations_to_audit: appears organized around final image labels
limited process trail in public release

candidates.title: VMXi Classification Dataset: Micrographs of Protein Crystallisation Experiments with Labels of Experimental Outcomes
reported_contents: three-expert label file for test set
candidates.why_relevant: Useful for testing label ambiguity and expert disagreement, but probably less event-native than time-trace data.
likely_strengths: clear labels and held-out test structure

candidates.title: OpenCrystalData
candidates.license: open access paper; dataset license requires Kaggle audit
candidates.why_relevant: Closest public crystallization PAT image resource found so far. Important to audit for sequence/process/provenance depth.
likely_limitations_to_audit: may be organized around image-analysis subtasks rather than full events

candidates.title: Data from: Optimizing gelation time for cell shape control through active learning
candidates.license: Dryad dataset; license requires page-level audit
candidates.why_relevant: Active-learning experimental workflow with gelation response surfaces. Useful for asking whether event logs survive beyond final response values.
likely_strengths: process variables such as temperature and pH
likely_limitations_to_audit: organized by figure rather than by event
raw data coverage may vary by figure
large enough to require selective download

candidates.title: High-Throughput Experimental Materials Database
candidates.license: public API; reuse terms require audit
candidates.why_relevant: Already useful as an event-proxy bridge from final sample rows toward spatial measurement fields.
likely_strengths: already supported within-library field prediction tests
known_limitations: sample-library snapshots rather than full event trajectories
held-out-library transfer from compressed metadata collapses
